messages.subject: select all choices
parts:
hello,
I have a shiny app with an selectInput Panel where i can choose between different countries and display a plot.
Is it possible to choose all countries at once and display the plot for the total number of values?
And if it's possible, how can I do it?

messages.author: e921049a2c056fbc
messages.subject: select all choices
parts: Add "select all" as one of the choices (in ui.R). Then, in server.R, say: if "select all" %in% input$choices... assign the vector of all choices to some variable, then pass it to your data frame/table to get all the columns. Else, pass whatever input$choices is.
